domains.target: Cloudflare Pages status shell backed by public-safe status telemetry

domains.purpose: Public-safe status, install, or identity helper paths
domains.target: Narrow edge or service surface behind Cloudflare proxy/WAF

bootstrap_steps: Point heiwa.ltd at the Cloudflare Pages marketing project.
Point status.heiwa.ltd at the Cloudflare Pages status shell.
Point docs.heiwa.ltd at the Cloudflare Pages docs project built from MkDocs Material.
Keep runtime control on the installed local heiwa runtime rather than a hosted product shell.
Attach api.heiwa.ltd only to public-safe helper paths such as status, install delivery, or identity exchange.
Keep SpacetimeDB external on maincloud.spacetimedb.com rather than modeling it as a Railway service or volume.
Keep internal preview runtimes such as heiwa-trading off the supported public host manifest until they graduate into first-class product surfaces.
Enable strict TLS and baseline WAF rules for api.heiwa.ltd while keeping the Pages shells behind Cloudflare edge controls.
Run post-cutover checks for api.heiwa.ltd/health, status.heiwa.ltd, and public page endpoints.
